risks.title: Cyclicality of semiconductor markets
risks.score_rationale: Risk is placed first in the 10-K, with strong language (material adverse effect) and focus on semiconductor markets, core of AST segment. Volatility in electronics demand and trade tensions amplify exposure. Macro category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on key customer (24% revenue)
risks.score_rationale: One customer represents 24% of consolidated sales in 2025, explicitly mentioned. Loss of this customer would have direct and major impact. Language is alarming (material adverse effect). Customer concentration is heightened by sector consolidation.

risks.title: Intense competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Risk is well developed, with mention of larger, better-resourced competitors. Commoditization risk is highlighted, along with impact of low-cost competitors. Central position in text, repeated language on adversity.

risks.title: Raw material shortage or price increases
risks.score_rationale: Mention of price increases, dependence on rare earths via China, and tariff risks. Text notes past and future effects. Supply uncertainty is clearly stated, with direct impact on costs.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Text mentions past attacks and increased risks via AI and quantum computing. Language is concerned (successful breach could have material effect). Major operational risk with impact on data, production, and reputation.

risks.title: Geographic dependence of customers
risks.score_rationale: AST customer base concentrated in Asia (Taiwan, Singapore) and United States. Text raises risk of shift due to public policy and geopolitical tensions. Cost of adjustment risk is explicit.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel or talent shortage
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned with moderate language (material adverse effect), but without reference to recent departures or clear trend. It is recurring in 10-Ks, so medium severity. Less weighted than major financial or operational risks.

ai_positioning.summary: NPO does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
